meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

copy.tagline_en: Query public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data on demand

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能按技能文档编写并运行 Python 代码,查询 CZ CELLxGENE Census 的版本化公开数据,获取单细胞与空间转录组的细胞元数据、基因表达、汇总计数、H5AD 下载地址等,再配合 scanpy 等做分析。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to write and run Python code that queries the CZ CELLxGENE Census API for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data, returning cell and gene metadata, expression slices, summary counts, H5AD download links, embeddings, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to query Census single-cell/spatial data by organism, tissue, disease, or cell type, or needs metadata, H5AD URLs, dataset lists, summary counts, or embeddings.
